::: {.callout-important title="This is a five-chapter pilot, not the complete workbook"}
This document contains **only Chapters 1 through 5** of *Modern LLM
Architecture: A Visual Guide to Attention, Memory, Sparsity, and Hybrid
Models* (workbook 04 of the ML/LLM Study Workbooks series). Chapters
6-8 -- case studies, architecture -> systems consequences, and a
synthesis/practice chapter -- are planned but **not drafted**. Nothing
in this document should be read as implying those chapters exist yet.
Multi-head latent attention (MLA), briefly deferred out of Chapter 3's
drafting pass, is now covered in Chapter 4 alongside sliding-window
and sparse attention. Chapter 4 covers recurrent/state-space/linear-attention
alternatives only as a brief taxonomy and forward reference, pending
adequate primary sourcing. Chapter 5 covers mixture-of-experts
architecture only -- detailed distributed-training implementation,
collective-communication algorithms, kernel optimization,
inference-engine configuration, expert quantization, model-specific
benchmark comparisons, post-training, and routing-research surveys are
all deferred to later workbooks or a future revision.

This is a review artifact: it exists to establish the workbook's
explanatory depth, visual language, page density, question style, and
citation style before the remaining chapters are drafted at scale.
Treat any rough edge you find as exactly the kind of thing this pilot
is meant to surface early.
:::
